images.alt: A satellite image on the left and a radar image on the right, both taken around &:30am this morning. The satellite image shows areas of greenish low cloud and redder higher clouds, with arrows point towards different areas pointing out low cloud/fog over auckland, stratocumulus cloud over kapiti and mountwain wave cloud over otago/southland. The rain radar half of the image has arrows pointing out the showers in kapiti, northland and offshore west coast, and virga over southland.

post.text:
😶‍🌫️ Mōrena Aotearoa, its a pretty sunny morning for lots of us today, but there's a few flies in the ointment 🌞

🌫️ Fog and low cloud lurk in a few places, including parts of Auckland. Send us cool pictures if you have one!

source.agency_name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand (MetService NZ)
